iteration_3_ci.note: Second GitLab CI run: build PASS, 17/18 tests pass, 1 real failure (TC-004 Price_AboveMax_Rejected).
iteration_3_ci.diagnosis: [Range(0,1000000)] uses int bounds; RangeAttribute converts the decimal 1000000.01 to int (rounds to 1000000) so it passes validation. Legacy/eShopPorted behave identically. Per parity-first + 'spec is truth', the TEST expectation was wrong, not the implementation.
fixes: Changed TC-004 boundary value to 1000001 (unambiguously > max; int Range rejects it).
Documented the int-Range rounding quirk in spec.json unknowns and a code comment.

blocking_issue.cause: No .NET SDK installed locally; containerized build via mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0 failed at NuGet restore with NU1301 (no outbound network to api.nuget.org inside the sandboxed container).
blocking_issue.classification: environment/toolchain limitation, not a code defect
blocking_issue.remediation: Run `dotnet restore && dotnet build && dotnet test` on a host with the .NET 8 SDK and NuGet access, or in CI (the generated GitHub Actions workflow does exactly this).
